text:
Congratulations for persevering in this matter and to people like Tamar Ohana who help (Lior Beres mentions her here) 

However, I would like to mention here that even though cases like this have been successful, the precedent it leaves has not (up to now) been helpful for others and I say this from a personal perspective 

Misrad Hapnim still refuses to acknowledge parent status and insists you have to go to Court. So we all end up having to pay huge amounts of money to the court system to receive this status too

My wife and I gave up insisting and trying to get MY children registered on my ID. The children have a British birth certificate with both our names on. When my wife went to the Israeli embassy in London to register their births the clerk wrote both our names on the paperwork. 
Mysteriously that paperwork disappeared!! 

It’s all a big ‘con’ by the department and my only hope is that we get a new Government this October who will listen to our plight and help us 🤞🏻🤞🏻🤞🏻
